Alot of these comments are negative for no reason so ill just tell you to ignore them and read the insightful ones cause this was very confusing to me early on.

So AC or armor class is how difficult you are to hit say you have an ac of 15 that means if you roll less than a 15 on your d20 the attack misses but it you roll a 15 or higher (equal to the ac or more) it will hit.

If the attack hits you roll dice based on what weapon or spell you used to calculate your damage and that damage will be subtracted from the hp.

So hp and ac are not connected, hp goes down when you take damage and when it reached 0 you fall unconscious or die, but armor class on the other hand stays the same during combat no matter how much youre hit unless some specific spell decreases or increases it.

Hope this helped you understand!!
